ModMetaData.name: M3AT: Maru's 3D Animated Toons
ModMetaData.author: maru mirai
ModMetaData.description:
Animated 3D pawns for IsoRim Waylith! Early WIP so expect some missing/jank/generic anims and other scuff, they'll be improved over time.
Some features: Basic anims for all the main stuff, movement, work, combat etc, more soon Wearable 3D apparel for everything in base game and all DLC + some of CE All hair mods supported via instant sprite-to-3d conversion + hair shows under hats Carrying/aiming/firing anims for all IsoRim's 3D weapons or sprite generated slab versions Visible holstered weapons, equipped or inventoried, with draw/holster anims Bodies for each of rimworld's body types, + gender differences + optional variation Visible worn equipment packs using IsoRim's models New camera mode designed for play with the more detailed pawns Visible injuries, bandages, scars, and missing limbs, matching the type and location, and severity Modeled and animated gene parts Injury-reactive idle and movement animations Ragdolls with optional physics flinging Smooth baby-adult growth and pregnancy for biotech Various body settings sliders CE support - backpack models, reload and hunker anims, webbing layer over armor support Optimization - GPU skinning, low poly models (Obviously still fairly performance heavy for a mod, I'll keep working on improvements)
Chibi Base by monymensss @ sketchfab
Serving suggestions: CE + IsoRimWaylith-CEPack Facial animation Retexture (Both used in screenshots)
I'll be adding support for more mods after improving on vanilla anims so check back here for updates
